verdict.rationale: Scheduling is a fair question for a cloud-hosted engine and editor platform, since scheduled builds or publishes are plausible. The evidence shows only on-demand automation surfaces: the Editor API, a REST API on paid plans, and an MCP server for AI-driven editing. These are developer building blocks or one-off actions, and nothing documents a recurring schedule, cron, or timed workflow feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
